mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, coupon_type, threshold_amount, discount_rate, reduce_amount, total_quantity, issued_quantity, per_limit, valid_from, valid_to, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM marketing_coupon WHERE deleted = FALSE
AND name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%')
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
